name: Grapple Sniper Arena
desc:
🔫 Welcome to Grapple Sniper Arena! 🪝

💥 Jump into fast-paced sniper battles where grappling, movement, and skill decide who wins! Grapple across the map, hook onto enemies, and deliver powerful dropkicks while landing deadly sniper shots!

🔥 Game Features
- 🪝 Grapple around the map and hook onto enemies!
- 💥 Dropkick opponents and send them flying!
- 🎯 Eliminate enemies with your sniper!
- 🏆 Compete in Free For All and Capture the Flag!
- ⚡ Master your movement and outplay your opponents!
- 💰 Earn Coins to unlock unique skins for your Sniper, Knife, and Grapple!
- 👥 Battle against friends or challenge other players!

🎮 Supported Devices
💻 PC, 📱 Mobile, 📱 Tablet, 🎮 Xbox, and PlayStation

⭐ Like and favorite the game for more updates!

⚠️ Rules
🚫 No exploiting, cheating, alt farming, or bug abusing. Breaking the rules can lead to a permanent ban.

llm.loop: spawn in arena -> grapple around, hook and dropkick enemies, snipe -> earn coins -> unlock skins
llm.objectives: eliminate opponents in Free For All or win Capture the Flag
llm.progression: coins for sniper, knife and grapple skins
llm.instructions: grapple across the map, hook enemies, dropkick and snipe them; no exploiting or cheating
unique: grapple hook pulls enemies in for dropkicks, mixed with sniper combat
llm.thumbnails: characters with sniper rifles mid-air, grapple hook pulling an enemy (HOOK!), dropkick with E KICK prompt, SHOOT! button overlays
llm.complexity_notes: grapple physics, sniper hit detection, two modes, cross-platform input including console
